Use case: precise-object-edit, children's picture book illustration.
Image 1 is the edit target: the page 9 bedroom background. Image 2 is the owl portrait reference.
Make a minimal edit to image 1. Keep exactly the existing close camera composition, wooden bed with curved arched headboard and round finials, cream pillow, deep blue blanket, purple-blue painted wall, lavender arched window at upper right with its crescent moon and stars, wood plank floor, brushwork, lighting, object sizes and locations.
Only change the inside of the empty landscape-format wooden picture frame at upper left: place a small painted portrait of the owl from image 2 on warm cream paper, fully contained in the inner opening. Preserve frame's original landscape proportions, perspective, warm orange-brown wood, outer shape and placement. Owl recognizable with brown feather tufts, cream face and belly, large dark eyes, golden collar feathers, small beak. Render owl as part of the room painting, gently textured with no white rectangular sticker outside frame, no second frame or added border. Painting fills inner opening; small cream margins around owl.
No child, person, story text, typography, logos, new furniture, or light trail. This is a background for separate personalized character and lettering layers. Full square opaque image, ideally native 2048 x 2048. Preserve the existing painterly direction and moderate saturation.
page10:
Use case: illustration-story. Background continuity edit for consecutive pages in children's picture book.
Image 1 is the authoritative bedroom identity: page 9 close view with owl picture.
Image 2 is the old page 10 composition: use only wider camera, open wall on right, bookshelf, rug and glowing trail as a composition reference.
Create page 10 as a wider view of EXACTLY THE SAME ROOM AS IMAGE 1. Imagine camera pulls back and pans a little right, keeping the relative positions of objects from image 1. Preserve room geometry: warm orange wood bed at left, rounded arch headboard and ball finials, cream pillow, deep royal-blue quilt, lavender-blue walls, lavender arch window directly to right of headboard, same landscape-format warm-wood OWL portrait above left part of headboard and to left of window. Frame must stay landscape, roughly 1.3:1 outer proportions, with same cream-background brown owl portrait, not an empty frame. Preserve recognizable owl face, tufts, golden feather collar. Frame, window and headboard should scale consistently as camera pulls back. Do not relocate window above the center of bed. Keep window adjacent right side of headboard as in image 1, lavender trim, deep blue night sky, same right-hand crescent moon, gold stars, purple clouds.
Wide composition: bed occupies lower-left half; its foot and legs visible. Tall open wall above and to right is clear for separate lettering. Small warm wood bookshelf with books and trailing plant near far right edge. Wood plank floor and soft blue oval rug across foreground. Golden glowing ribbon begins beside foot of bed near lower left and winds gently across rug toward lower-right edge, with a few small gold lights. Trail belongs to image 2's story moment. Maintain same painted texture, colors and gentle lighting as image 1. Muted purple shadows and warm amber highlights, avoid increasing saturation.
No child, person, animal outside portrait, story text, typography, watermark, corner of another room, added windows or extra pictures. Square opaque background, ideally native 2048 x 2048.
